decisions.reason: The source clarifies physical placement options for small connectors but does not change the three-board architecture or any board role.
The source does not override the power board's established form factor or specific battery-connector location and clearance constraints.
The existing same-message Event already captures the dimension flexibility relevant to this Requirement; small-connector placement belongs to the separate connector-layout Requirement.
Connector accessibility and placement do not change the power board's four-layer stack requirement.
The source does not change the charge-status indication path, connector specification, resistor configuration, or LED population.
The source changes general connector-layout options, not the reset input's electrical behavior, designator, or panel-mounted implementation.
Permitting top or side placement for small connectors does not change the sensor board's connector inventory, connector types, pinouts, or hub role.
The source does not alter the interboard signal connector types, references, pin counts, or pinouts; physical placement is owned by the connector-layout Requirement.
The source does not change the interboard power topology, connector specifications, references, or pin-order rule.
The source does not change the panel power button's connector, main-board location, PWRON connection, or switching behavior.
The source does not resolve or change the battery connector's family, pin count, functions, accessibility requirement, or unresolved pin order.
Changing permitted physical connector placement does not alter the requirement to mark connector pins on the bottom of the power board.
